use_cases: AI chat interface prompt input with auto-resizing text area
Multi-provider AI model selection dropdown with visual icons
Text submission with keyboard shortcuts for AI interactions
Dark mode compatible prompt interface for AI tools
Modern chatbot input field with provider switching
ai_summary: A modern AI prompt input component featuring an auto-resizing textarea, dropdown menu for selecting AI providers (OpenAI, Anthropic), and submission controls. Includes dark mode support, keyboard navigation, and smooth animations. Ideal for building AI chat interfaces, chatbot UIs, and prompt engineering tools in SaaS applications and developer platforms.
